def: New York's Responsible AI Safety and Education Act, signed December 2025 and rewritten by a March 2026 chapter amendment to closely follow California SB 53's duties for frontier AI developers.
practice: Takes effect 1 January 2027 with the same 10²⁶-operation and USD 500 million thresholds as California, but a 72-hour incident deadline and a new oversight office in the Department of Financial Services.
aliases: Responsible AI Safety and Education Act
